# Letter of Collaboration — template

*(Print on the NGO's letterhead. Replace everything in [brackets].)*

**Date:** [DD/MM/YYYY]

To,
[Faculty guide name], [Department], [College name], [City]

**Subject:** Collaboration for the field pilot of "GramText: Devanagari Sign & Prescription Reader"

Dear Sir/Madam,

[NGO name], registered under [Act / registration number], works on [health / literacy / women's
empowerment] in [district(s), state]. We are pleased to collaborate with the student team
[team names / projexa team 26040] of [college name] on the GramText project. GramText is a mobile
app that photographs printed Hindi and English text and reads it aloud.

As part of this collaboration, [NGO name] agrees to:

1. Help identify [number] community participants (for example, ASHA workers, self-help-group
   members and elderly residents) for a field pilot between [start date] and [end date] at
   [village / centre].
2. Give feedback on usability for low-literacy users, and help run the community feedback form.
3. Provide a staff coordinator: [name, role, phone].

The student team agrees to:

1. Use only consenting participants. Collect no names, photos of faces, or real prescriptions
   without explicit permission. Store only anonymous usage counts and voluntary feedback.
2. Make clear that the app only reads text aloud and gives **no medical advice**.
3. Share the pilot findings and impact report with [NGO name].

This letter does not create any financial obligation for either party.

Yours sincerely,

[Signature and stamp]
[Name], [Designation], [NGO name]
[Phone] · [Email]
